entities.name: Pōmare II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pōmare II, was the second king of Tahiti between 1791 and 1821. He was installed by his father Pōmare I at Tarahoi, 13 February 1791. He ruled under regency from 1791 to 1803.
